text:
sam: Heads-up: sample-app streaming resume test failing intermittently. After reconnect we sometimes get event fragments in wrong order (second chunk arrives before the first), parser ends up concatenating partial JSON and erroring.
lucy: yikes. which SDK/runtime? any auth refresh in between?
sam: js/browser SDK (latest). flow: xhr abort -> sdk reconnect with Last-Event-ID. sometimes the server sends: `data: {\"seq\":2,...}` then `data: {\"seq\":1,...}`. logs:
[recv] chunk1 len=48 seq=2 data="{\"seq\":2,\"text\":\"ok\"}"
[recv] chunk2 len=56 seq=1 data="{\"seq\":1,\"text\":\"hello\"}"
[parser] assembled => "{\"seq\":2,\"text\":\"ok\"}{\"seq\":1,\"text\":\"hello\"}" -> json parse error

theo: that's suspicious. Could be proxy/connection reuse returning buffered writes out of order. Does `curl --no-buffer` repro?
sam: tried curl --no-buffer -> never repros. only in browser behind dev proxy (mitm). Also noticed it spikes when token refresh fires (auth request to /oauth/refresh) at same time as reconnect.
lucy: maybe two requests multiplexed on same backend connection and our proxy interleaves chunk writes. If token refresh triggers a tiny POST that reuses connection, chunked framing could be interleaved.
sam: yeah that fits. Repro steps added to sample-app/streaming/README: reproduce by forcing token refresh during reconnect (set short TTL).
theo: quick mitigation: SDK should coalesce incoming bytes into a buffer and only split events on a full SSE event delimiter ("\n\n") rather than assuming each websocket chunk == event. Also record event seq numbers when present and drop out-of-order ones until we see missing seq (for safety).
sam: adding a local test harness that simulates interleaved writes. sample code snippet to reproduce server-side (node):
```js
const http = require('http');
// write part of seq2, then seq1 interleaved
res.write('data: {"seq":2,"text":"ok"}\n\n');
setTimeout(() => res.write('data: {"seq":1,"text":"hello"}\n\n'), 1);
```
lucy: small ask for infra: can we enable per-connection single-threaded writes (disable keepalive pooling) in dev proxy to verify?
infra-bot: Request filed to eng-infra: INF-887 (enable serialized writes for dev proxy on test host).
devex-bot: Created DEX-1150 "streaming: client sees interleaved chunk order on reconnect behind proxy; add buffer-splitting + seq-tolerant parser". Assigning to @theo.
theo: I'll open a PR to SDK with a defensive parser: buffer until `\n\n` seen, allow optional `seq` header handling, and add test cases. Also will add a telemetry counter for `sse.out_of_order` so we can monitor in prod.
sam: thanks. I'll attach the harness and a minimal repro app to the issue. planning to ship the SDK patch behind a feature flag so we can roll back quickly if it causes regressions.
lucy: perfect. small note: make sure the parser still forwards comments/retry lines correctly.
sam: noted. closing loop once infra confirms serialized writes test. :white_check_mark:
